method: Targeted terms 5a5d6e76fda4.txt (45,186 chars), §§4,6,12, termination and guidelines excerpts; full §12 profit-sharing passage read; related help/risk pages not fully read.

facts.text: §12 Risk Team can add requirements for “trading irregularities” or signs of inconsistency/gambling before approving payout; violations of risk parameters and undefined toxic activity “may result in forfeiture of profits and termination”.

§12 Customization requires trading until best-day ratio below target; 510Zero reward reduced to 10% if performance below 6%, or 8% for clients from Vietnam/Indonesia/Thailand. Reactivate Profit Sharing reduces next split to 20%, then gradually restores 50–90%.
§4 replication discretionary; rewards subject to internal policies and not guaranteed; distinguish admission/replication from earned entitlement.

rejected.B1: §12 forfeiture linked to rule noncompliance; §4 discretionary replication does not itself prove unconditional revocation of earned rewards.
rejected.B3: Generic continued-use amendment and guidelines change, no explicit already-running scope.
rejected.B7: Guidelines on website and via email upon becoming Trader; withholding before purchase not established.
